Can you tell me how to kill the lights in my room?

If you mean **turn off the lights**, use the wall switch, lamp switch, or smart-home control. If they won’t turn off, unplug the lamp or switch off the corresponding circuit breaker—only if it’s safe and you can identify it. Don’t touch exposed wiring.
